tools.name: search_ufc_cards
tools.description: Search Octagon's UFC catalogue by fighter, year, release, card number, parallel or print run. Returns matching edition IDs and links for card identification before a value lookup. A query can match several editions. Does not identify uploaded photos or search other sports.

tools.name: get_ufc_card_evidence
tools.description: Read the saved estimate and recent recorded sales for one exact UFC card version identified by its catalogue cardId. Prices are USD. The estimate pools raw and graded sales and is not a physical-copy or grader-specific appraisal. Returns dates, known sale sources, a history truncation flag and an Oc

tools.name: get_ufc_card_comparables
tools.description: Read up to eight selected comparable sales for an identified UFC card version, including match reasons and differences. Comparisons may include other parallels, releases or fighters. Related editions are not exact-card sales. Returns partial and unavailable status when applicable.
